source_truth_policy: BCV is canonical for monetary and official-FX observations; SUDEBAN and bank statements are canonical for banking observations; parallel FX and physical-dollar circulation are separately constructed and never silently equated with official data.

layers.authority: Survey, banking, payment, and market evidence
IMF, World Bank, IDB, UNDP, OPEC, ECLAC

acquisition_rules: Original BCV file preferred over press quotation.
BCV liquidez monetaria is retained as VEN_BCV_LIQUIDEZ and is not silently relabeled as standardized IMF M2.
Every observation preserves observation date, publication date, revision date, original URL, local artifact, SHA-256, and retrieval timestamp.
A secondary report can enter as PROVISIONAL or DISPUTED but cannot replace the primary source of truth.
Physical USD cash, bank USD deposits, and USDT remain separate categories.
Parallel FX uses timestamp-matched observations and a documented composite method.
No current policy gate opens from a lead observation alone.
